rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Parked kerb with homes 18-25 m away, beside a school and kindergarten.

drivers.seclusion: Houses 18-31 m behind the kerb on the same side; trees and flats opposite. Not remote.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb with a row of cars already parked; room for a van in the line.
drivers.traffic: Local street with school drop-off activity on schooldays.
drivers.convention: Dense parking suggests overflow from the school and kindergarten; a van blends in by day.

flags: Homes within 18-25 m on own side
1/2P parking on schooldays 7am-7pm; No Stopping Any Time at the ends
Kindergarten and school nearby: busy at drop-off
Slope reaches about 5% in places along the stretch
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the western half; open to the north-east at the east end.

best_section.where: South kerb of Macquarie Street, mid-way along the parked row
